For every m>=1 an ordinary integer matrix with the same exact margins and rank98 can be chosen whose Gram is H modulo3^m, with coherent successive residues. This does not require or assert binary entries, nonnegative entries, triangle supports, or an ordinary integer exact-Gram factor.
